metadata.scope: crash recovery, archive recovery (PITR), hot-standby continuous recovery, the redo loop, recovery conflicts, restartpoints, timeline switches, promotion

StartupProcessMain.overview: Startup auxiliary process main entry point. Forked by the postmaster, registers signal handlers and standby timeouts, then calls StartupXLOG.

StartupXLOG.overview: Top-level XLOG/recovery driver invoked once during startup. Reads pg_control, dispatches between crash/archive/standby recovery, drives the redo loop, then transitions the cluster into production. Lives at xlog.c line ~5384.

InitWalRecovery.overview: Initializes WAL recovery state from pg_control plus signal/backup-label files. Decides crash vs archive vs standby, validates parameters, sets up the XLogReader/XLogPrefetcher, and computes the starting REDO point.

PerformWalRecovery.overview: The redo loop. Calls RmgrStartup, then repeatedly ReadRecord -> ApplyWalRecord, checks recoveryStopsBefore/After, recovery pause, processes recovery_min_apply_delay, updates lastReplayed* state, finally RmgrCleanup.

FinishWalRecovery.overview: Pre-promotion finalization. Confirms last applied record, captures end-of-WAL state and partial-page bytes, prepares EndOfWalRecoveryInfo for StartupXLOG to consume.

ShutdownWalRecovery.overview: Tears down recovery-only state (XLogReader, XLogPrefetcher, possibly walreceiver) before transitioning into production.

ApplyWalRecord.overview: Inner step of the redo loop. Advances nextXid, processes timeline switch when checkpoint/end-of-recovery records are seen, records xids in KnownAssignedXids, dispatches to GetRmgr(rmid).rm_redo, then verifies backup-page consistency and updates lastReplayed* state.

ReadRecord.overview: Wraps XLogPrefetcherReadRecord; on EOF or error consults WaitForWALToBecomeAvailable to switch source (pg_wal/archive/stream); also handles standby promote-trigger checks.

XLogPageRead.overview: Page-level read callback registered into XLogReaderRoutine.page_read. Calls WaitForWALToBecomeAvailable to find/open a segment, reads BLCKSZ bytes, validates header.

WaitForWALToBecomeAvailable.overview: Source-selection state machine. Tries pg_wal, archive (via RestoreArchivedFile + restore_command), and streaming (via RequestXLogStreaming + walreceiver), retrying with backoff. Exposes XLOG_FROM_PG_WAL / XLOG_FROM_ARCHIVE / XLOG_FROM_STREAM transitions.

XLogReaderAllocate.overview: Allocates XLogReaderState, copies the caller-supplied XLogReaderRoutine (page_read/segment_open/segment_close), allocates decode buffers. Used by recovery, walsender, pg_waldump, pg_rewind.

XLogReaderFree.overview: Frees an XLogReaderState and its decoded-record buffers.

XLogReadRecord.overview: Reads, validates, and decodes the next WAL record from the position previously set by XLogBeginRead. Handles continuation records spanning pages.

XLogReaderRoutine.overview: Callback-table struct (page_read, segment_open, segment_close) supplied by callers of XLogReaderAllocate. Sole abstraction allowing recovery, walsender, pg_waldump, and pg_rewind to share the reader.

XLogPrefetcherAllocate.overview: Allocates the prefetch wrapper around an XLogReaderState. Owns a hash filter table and the pgsr stream.

XLogPrefetcherBeginRead.overview: Resets prefetcher state and positions the underlying reader at recPtr.

XLogPrefetcherReadRecord.overview: Wrapper that, when recovery_prefetch is enabled, requests asynchronous reads of upcoming blocks before the redo loop touches them. Falls back to plain XLogReadRecord when disabled.

XLogPrefetcherNextBlock.overview: Per-record analysis: examines decoded blocks, decides whether to prefetch each one (PrefetchSharedBuffer), and applies filters that suppress lookups for relations that have just been dropped/truncated within the WAL stream.

RmgrStartup.overview: Calls every non-NULL rm_startup hook in RmgrTable[] (e.g. btree_xlog_startup, gin_xlog_startup). Invoked once at the top of PerformWalRecovery.

RmgrCleanup.overview: Mirror of RmgrStartup that runs each rm_cleanup hook at the end of the redo loop.

GetRmgr.overview: Inline lookup into RmgrTable[]. Used by ApplyWalRecord (rm_redo) and pg_get_wal_resource_managers SQL function.

RmgrTable.overview: Static array of RmgrData (one entry per resource manager), generated from rmgrlist.h via the PG_RMGR macro. Indexed by rmgr id stored in xl_rmid.

RegisterCustomRmgr.overview: Extension point: lets shared libraries register a custom RmgrData (used by extensions like neon, citus). Runs from _PG_init.

validateRecoveryParameters.overview: Cross-checks recovery_target_*, primary_conninfo, restore_command. Mutually-exclusive recovery target validation; rewrites recoveryTargetAction=PAUSE to SHUTDOWN if hot_standby is off.

read_backup_label.overview: Parses backup_label produced by pg_basebackup. If present, recovery starts from the LSN it specifies instead of pg_control->checkPoint, and recovery cannot stop before the backup-end record.

read_tablespace_map.overview: Parses tablespace_map distributed with the base backup. Drives recovery's recreation of tablespace symlinks before pg_wal replay touches the data.

ReadControlFile.overview: Reads pg_control from disk and verifies CRC. Determines pg_control->state (DB_SHUTDOWNED, DB_IN_PRODUCTION, etc) which dispatches into crash vs archive recovery.

UpdateControlFile.overview: Writes pg_control back to disk with a fresh CRC. Called whenever DBState transitions or minRecoveryPoint, checkPoint, etc. are advanced.

ControlFileData.overview: On-disk pg_control struct. Fields critical to recovery: state, checkPoint, checkPointCopy, minRecoveryPoint, minRecoveryPointTLI, backupStartPoint, backupEndPoint, backupEndRequired, system_identifier.

DBState.overview: Enum tracking cluster lifecycle: DB_STARTUP, DB_SHUTDOWNED, DB_SHUTDOWNED_IN_RECOVERY, DB_SHUTDOWNING, DB_IN_CRASH_RECOVERY, DB_IN_ARCHIVE_RECOVERY, DB_IN_PRODUCTION.

CheckPoint.overview: Body of CHECKPOINT WAL record. Contains redo (REDO start), ThisTimeLineID/PrevTimeLineID, nextXid, oldestXid, oldestMulti, oldestActiveXid. A copy is kept in pg_control as checkPointCopy.

RestoreArchivedFile.overview: Implements restore_command. Substitutes %f/%p/%r and runs the shell command via system(). Returns true on success and copies the recovered file into pg_wal.

ExecuteRecoveryCommand.overview: Common shell wrapper for restore_command, archive_cleanup_command, recovery_end_command. Substitutes %f/%p/%r and reports nonzero exit codes.

KeepFileRestoredFromArchive.overview: After restore_command returns success, moves the recovered file into place atomically and updates archive_status accordingly.

XLogArchiveCheckDone.overview: Decides whether a finished WAL segment may be deleted/recycled given archive_status state.

recoveryStopsBefore.overview: Pre-apply stop predicate. Returns true (and stores info into recoveryStopXid/Time/LSN/Name) when the next record matches recovery_target_xid/time/lsn/name AND recovery_target_inclusive is false.

recoveryStopsAfter.overview: Post-apply stop predicate. Inclusive variant: stops after applying the matching record. Also handles XLOG_RESTORE_POINT named targets.

recoveryPausesHere.overview: Honors recovery_target_action=pause and pg_wal_replay_pause(). Sleeps inside the redo loop until SetRecoveryPause(false) is called.

recoveryApplyDelay.overview: Implements recovery_min_apply_delay GUC. For COMMIT records, waits commit_time + delay before applying; supports SIGHUP and pause checks.

CheckRecoveryConsistency.overview: Determines when the standby has reached a consistent state (replay >= minRecoveryPoint and beyond backupEndPoint). Sets reachedConsistency, opens hot standby (LocalHotStandbyActive=true), allows backends to log in.

RecoveryRestartPoint.overview: Notifies the checkpointer that we just replayed a checkpoint record so it can issue a CreateRestartPoint. Updates XLogCtl with the latest replayed checkpoint location.

CreateRestartPoint.overview: The restartpoint counterpart of CreateCheckPoint. Runs CheckPointGuts (flush dirty buffers, sync SLRUs), updates ControlFile->minRecoveryPoint and checkPoint, recycles old pg_wal segments, runs archive_cleanup_command.

CheckPointGuts.overview: Flushes dirty buffers, fsync SLRUs (CLOG, MultiXact, CommitTs, SubTrans), used by both checkpoints and restartpoints.

checkTimeLineSwitch.overview: When ApplyWalRecord sees a checkpoint or end-of-recovery record from a different TLI, this function validates that the new TLI is a legitimate descendant in expectedTLEs.

readTimeLineHistory.overview: Parses the <TLI>.history file (fetching from archive if required) and returns a List of TimeLineHistoryEntry. Foundation of every TLI cross-check.

writeTimeLineHistory.overview: Creates <newTLI>.history at promotion. Concatenates parent's history file plus a new line: previous TLI, switchpoint LSN, reason ('no recovery target specified', etc).

findNewestTimeLine.overview: Probes for <tli>.history files with increasing TLI to find the latest. Used at archive-recovery start and at promotion to compute newTLI = parent + 1.

tliOfPointInHistory.overview: Given an LSN and a history list, returns the TLI active at that point.

WalReceiverMain.overview: Walreceiver auxiliary process entry. Reads WalRcv->receiveStart, dlopens libpqwalreceiver, walrcv_connect, walrcv_startstreaming, then loops walrcv_receive -> XLogWalRcvWrite -> XLogWalRcvFlush -> XLogWalRcvSendReply.

WalRcvWaitForStartPosition.overview: After streaming ends or before the first stream, blocks the walreceiver waiting for the startup process to update WalRcv->receiveStart and signal latch.

RequestXLogStreaming.overview: Called by startup process from WaitForWALToBecomeAvailable to spawn (or restart) walreceiver. Fills WalRcv->receiveStart, conninfo, slotname, sets walRcvState=WALRCV_STARTING, sends PMSIGNAL_START_WALRECEIVER.

ShutdownWalRcv.overview: Sets WalRcvState=WALRCV_STOPPING, kills the walreceiver, waits for WALRCV_STOPPED. Used during promotion and after consistent-recovery TLI switch.

WalRcvData.overview: Shared-memory struct describing the walreceiver. Fields: pid, walRcvState, receiveStart/receiveStartTLI, flushedUpto/receivedTLI, latestChunkStart, conninfo, slotname, latch, writtenUpto, force_reply.

WalReceiverFunctionsType.overview: Function-pointer table populated by libpqwalreceiver dynamic library: walrcv_connect, walrcv_identify_system, walrcv_startstreaming, walrcv_receive, walrcv_send, walrcv_create_slot, walrcv_disconnect.

XLogWalRcvWrite.overview: Writes a chunk of received WAL bytes into pg_wal segments via XLogFileInit/open. Called from the WalReceiverMain loop.

XLogWalRcvFlush.overview: Fsyncs received WAL up to walrcv->writtenUpto, advances flushedUpto, signals the startup process latch so PerformWalRecovery can apply more.

RecoveryInProgress.overview: Global predicate consulted by every backend before any write path. Caches LocalRecoveryInProgress; once it sees SharedRecoveryState==RECOVERY_STATE_DONE it never flips back, and can never be re-armed in this process. Backbone of read-only-during-recovery.

HotStandbyActive.overview: Returns true once recovery has reached consistency AND hot_standby=on AND consistent snapshot is available. Gates whether backends can connect to a standby.

InitRecoveryTransactionEnvironment.overview: Sets up the environment that lets the startup process behave like a transaction-aware backend: takes a virtual XID, registers in the procarray, initializes KnownAssignedXids tracking. Called only when EnableHotStandby.

ShutdownRecoveryTransactionEnvironment.overview: Mirror of InitRecoveryTransactionEnvironment. Releases virtual XID, drains KnownAssignedXids, removes startup procarray entry.

ProcArrayApplyRecoveryInfo.overview: Consumes XLOG_RUNNING_XACTS records emitted by primary's LogStandbySnapshot. Drains KnownAssignedXids, repopulates from xlrec->xids[], updates oldestActiveXid, sets standbyState to STANDBY_SNAPSHOT_PENDING/READY.

KnownAssignedXids.overview: Standby-side mirror of in-flight primary XIDs. Sorted ring of TransactionIds, kept in sync via XLOG_RUNNING_XACTS, XLOG_XACT_ASSIGNMENT, XLOG_XACT_COMMIT/ABORT. Read by GetSnapshotData on the standby.

RecordKnownAssignedTransactionIds.overview: Adds an XID seen in a WAL record to KnownAssignedXids. Called from ApplyWalRecord whenever standbyState >= STANDBY_INITIALIZED.

ExpireTreeKnownAssignedTransactionIds.overview: Removes a parent XID and its (sub)children from KnownAssignedXids on commit/abort.

LogStandbySnapshot.overview: On the PRIMARY: emits XLOG_RUNNING_XACTS record describing all running XIDs and access-exclusive locks. Emitted at every checkpoint and via bgwriter heartbeat (LOG_SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_MS).

LogAccessExclusiveLock.overview: PRIMARY-side: emits XLOG_STANDBY_LOCK so the standby can replay AccessExclusiveLock acquisitions and avoid hot-standby clients reading torn DDL state.

StandbyAcquireAccessExclusiveLock.overview: STANDBY-side: applies XLOG_STANDBY_LOCK by registering a virtual lock under the lock-tag's transaction, so future hot-standby queries see the conflict.

StandbyReleaseAllLocks.overview: Releases every lock acquired by StandbyAcquireAccessExclusiveLock at recovery exit.

ResolveRecoveryConflictWithSnapshot.overview: Resolver for PROCSIG_RECOVERY_CONFLICT_SNAPSHOT. Computes the list of conflicting backends with snapshots older than snapshotConflictHorizon, signals each PROCSIG, then waits up to max_standby_*_delay for them to release/exit.

ResolveRecoveryConflictWithDatabase.overview: Resolver for PROCSIG_RECOVERY_CONFLICT_DATABASE. Used when XLOG_DBASE_DROP is replayed: kicks every backend connected to the dropped database.

ResolveRecoveryConflictWithTablespace.overview: Resolver for PROCSIG_RECOVERY_CONFLICT_TABLESPACE. Replay of XLOG_TBLSPC_DROP: kicks backends with temp files in the tablespace.

ResolveRecoveryConflictWithLock.overview: Resolver invoked by ProcSleep when the startup process waits for an AccessExclusiveLock held by a backend (or vice versa). Cancels the conflicting backend after max_standby_*_delay.

ResolveRecoveryConflictWithBufferPin.overview: Resolver for PROCSIG_RECOVERY_CONFLICT_BUFFERPIN. Triggered when the startup process needs cleanup access to a buffer that another backend has pinned. Sets timer; on expiry, signals the holder.

ResolveRecoveryConflictWithVirtualXIDs.overview: Common subroutine: given a list of VirtualTransactionIds, signals each PROCSIG conflict reason, sleeps up to max_standby_*_delay; logs via LogRecoveryConflict on long waits.

HandleRecoveryConflictInterrupt.overview: Backend-side signal handler. Sets RecoveryConflictPending = true and the per-reason flag, then SetLatch.

ProcessRecoveryConflictInterrupt.overview: Backend-side: at next CHECK_FOR_INTERRUPTS, dispatches per-reason: SNAPSHOT/TABLESPACE/LOCK -> ereport(ERROR), STARTUP_DEADLOCK -> elevate to FATAL, BUFFERPIN -> release pin, DATABASE -> proc_exit.

CheckRecoveryConflictDeadlock.overview: Detects deadlock between startup process (waiting on AccessExclusiveLock) and a backend (pinning a buffer or holding a lock that startup needs). Triggers PROCSIG_RECOVERY_CONFLICT_STARTUP_DEADLOCK.

LogRecoveryConflict.overview: Emits structured log message when a recovery conflict wait exceeds deadlock_timeout (gated by log_recovery_conflict_waits).

RecoverPreparedTransactions.overview: End-of-crash-recovery hook: scans pg_twophase, rebuilds GXACT entries, takes locks, registers each prepared transaction so it survives into production.

StandbyRecoverPreparedTransactions.overview: Hot-standby variant: rebuilds GXACT shmem entries from pg_twophase but does NOT take heavyweight locks; locks come via XLOG_STANDBY_LOCK records replayed by standby_redo.

RestoreTwoPhaseData.overview: Initial scan of pg_twophase at startup to seed in-memory two-phase state before replay begins.

PrepareRedoAdd.overview: Replays XLOG_XACT_PREPARE: records the prepared-xact header in shmem so subsequent commit_prepared/abort_prepared can find it.

PrepareRedoRemove.overview: Replays commit_prepared / abort_prepared by removing the GXACT entry.

pg_promote.overview: SQL-callable promotion. Sends PMSIGNAL_PROMOTE to postmaster (which forwards to startup process), waits up to wait_seconds for SharedRecoveryState==RECOVERY_STATE_DONE.

CheckPromoteSignal.overview: Returns true if the 'promote' signal file exists in $PGDATA. Polled by the redo loop and by CheckForStandbyTrigger.

CheckForStandbyTrigger.overview: Inside-startup variant: polls IsPromoteSignaled atomic plus the 'promote' file. When set, sets standbyState=STANDBY_DISABLED and the redo loop terminates as soon as the next ReadRecord fails.

PromoteIsTriggered.overview: Public predicate exported from xlogrecovery.h. Returns LocalPromoteIsTriggered (set by SignalPromotion).

RemovePromoteSignalFiles.overview: Deletes the 'promote' file once promotion has been observed, so a subsequent crash-recovery does not auto-promote.

WakeupRecovery.overview: Sets the startup process latch. Called by walreceiver after each flush, by checkpointer, and by SetRecoveryPause(false).

SwitchIntoArchiveRecovery.overview: Mid-redo transition: when crash recovery exhausts pg_wal but recovery.signal is still present, switches StandbyMode/InArchiveRecovery state and bumps timeline.

ReachedEndOfBackup.overview: Replay of XLOG_BACKUP_END (or shutdown checkpoint past backupEndPoint): clears backupStartPoint/backupEndPoint/backupEndRequired, signaling that the cluster is now consistent w.r.t. the original base backup.

RemoveNonParentXlogFiles.overview: After a timeline switch, deletes WAL segments past the switchpoint that belonged to the old TLI (since they are now obsolete).

xlog_redo.overview: RM_XLOG_ID redo. Handles XLOG_NEXTOID, XLOG_CHECKPOINT_SHUTDOWN, XLOG_CHECKPOINT_ONLINE, XLOG_PARAMETER_CHANGE, XLOG_NOOP, XLOG_SWITCH, XLOG_BACKUP_END, XLOG_RESTORE_POINT, XLOG_FPW_CHANGE, XLOG_END_OF_RECOVERY, XLOG_FPI / XLOG_FPI_FOR_HINT, XLOG_OVERWRITE_CONTRECORD, XLOG_CHECKPOINT_REDO. Calls RecoveryRestartPoint on checkpoint records.

xact_redo.overview: RM_XACT_ID redo. Dispatches XLOG_XACT_COMMIT/ABORT/PREPARE/COMMIT_PREPARED/ABORT_PREPARED/ASSIGNMENT/INVALIDATIONS to xact_redo_commit/abort and PrepareRedoAdd/Remove.

xact_redo_commit.overview: Replays a commit record: marks XID committed in CLOG, applies invalidation messages, processes new shared-inval messages, processes filenodesToDelete (drop relations), updates oldestActiveXid.

xact_redo_abort.overview: Replays an abort record: marks XID aborted in CLOG, drops relfilenodes that were created by the aborted transaction, updates KnownAssignedXids.

smgr_redo.overview: RM_SMGR_ID redo. Handles XLOG_SMGR_CREATE (smgrcreate of new relfilenode) and XLOG_SMGR_TRUNCATE (smgrtruncate to a smaller block count).

clog_redo.overview: RM_CLOG_ID redo. Handles CLOG_ZEROPAGE (zero a new clog page) and CLOG_TRUNCATE (advance clog truncation).

dbase_redo.overview: RM_DBASE_ID redo. Handles XLOG_DBASE_CREATE_FILE_COPY (copy template1 by file copy), XLOG_DBASE_CREATE_WAL_LOG (record-based DB creation), XLOG_DBASE_DROP. The drop path triggers ResolveRecoveryConflictWithDatabase.

tblspc_redo.overview: RM_TBLSPC_ID redo. Handles XLOG_TBLSPC_CREATE (create symlink) and XLOG_TBLSPC_DROP (after clearing temp files via ResolveRecoveryConflictWithTablespace).

multixact_redo.overview: RM_MULTIXACT_ID redo. Handles XLOG_MULTIXACT_ZERO_OFF_PAGE, XLOG_MULTIXACT_ZERO_MEM_PAGE, XLOG_MULTIXACT_CREATE_ID, XLOG_MULTIXACT_TRUNCATE_ID.

relmap_redo.overview: RM_RELMAP_ID redo. Handles XLOG_RELMAP_UPDATE: rewrites pg_filenode.map for the appropriate database/global mapper.

standby_redo.overview: RM_STANDBY_ID redo. Handles XLOG_STANDBY_LOCK (StandbyAcquireAccessExclusiveLock), XLOG_RUNNING_XACTS (ProcArrayApplyRecoveryInfo + pgstat_report_stat), XLOG_INVALIDATIONS (ProcessCommittedInvalidationMessages).

heap_redo.overview: RM_HEAP_ID redo. Dispatches XLOG_HEAP_INSERT/DELETE/UPDATE/HOT_UPDATE/CONFIRM/LOCK/INPLACE/TRUNCATE to heap_xlog_*. Does NOT process snapshot conflicts (heap2_redo does).

heap2_redo.overview: RM_HEAP2_ID redo. Handles XLOG_HEAP2_PRUNE_ON_ACCESS/_VACUUM_SCAN/_VACUUM_CLEANUP -> heap_xlog_prune_freeze (calls ResolveRecoveryConflictWithSnapshot), XLOG_HEAP2_VISIBLE -> heap_xlog_visible (sets VM bit, conflict-with-snapshot), XLOG_HEAP2_MULTI_INSERT, XLOG_HEAP2_LOCK_UPDATED, XLOG_HEAP2_NEW_CID (logical only), XLOG_HEAP2_REWRITE.

btree_redo.overview: RM_BTREE_ID redo. Handles INSERT_LEAF/UPPER/META, SPLIT_*, DEDUP, VACUUM, DELETE, MARK_PAGE_HALFDEAD, UNLINK_PAGE, NEWROOT, REUSE_PAGE. The DELETE path calls ResolveRecoveryConflictWithSnapshot. Has rm_startup/rm_cleanup hooks (incomplete-split tracker).

hash_redo.overview: RM_HASH_ID redo. Handles INIT_META_PAGE, INIT_BITMAP_PAGE, INSERT, ADD_OVFL_PAGE, SPLIT_*, DELETE, UPDATE_META_PAGE, VACUUM_ONE_PAGE.

gin_redo.overview: RM_GIN_ID redo. Has rm_startup (gin_xlog_startup) / rm_cleanup (gin_xlog_cleanup) hooks. Dispatches CREATE_PTREE, INSERT, SPLIT, VACUUM_PAGE, VACUUM_DATA_LEAF_PAGE, DELETE_PAGE, UPDATE_META_PAGE, INSERT_LISTPAGE, DELETE_LISTPAGE.

gist_redo.overview: RM_GIST_ID redo. Has rm_startup/rm_cleanup hooks. Dispatches PAGE_UPDATE, DELETE, PAGE_REUSE, PAGE_SPLIT, ASSIGN_LSN, PAGE_DELETE.

spg_redo.overview: RM_SPGIST_ID redo. Has rm_startup/rm_cleanup hooks. Handles ADD_LEAF, MOVE_LEAFS, ADD_NODE, SPLIT_TUPLE, PICKSPLIT, VACUUM_LEAF, VACUUM_ROOT, VACUUM_REDIRECT.

brin_redo.overview: RM_BRIN_ID redo. Handles CREATE_INDEX, INSERT, UPDATE, SAMEPAGE_UPDATE, REVMAP_EXTEND, DESUMMARIZE.

seq_redo.overview: RM_SEQ_ID redo. Single op XLOG_SEQ_LOG: copies the WAL-recorded sequence tuple onto the page.

commit_ts_redo.overview: RM_COMMIT_TS_ID redo. Handles COMMIT_TS_ZEROPAGE and COMMIT_TS_TRUNCATE for the pg_commit_ts SLRU.

replorigin_redo.overview: RM_REPLORIGIN_ID redo. Handles XLOG_REPLORIGIN_SET, XLOG_REPLORIGIN_DROP for replication-origin progress tracking.

generic_redo.overview: RM_GENERIC_ID redo. Replays page-level diff records produced by extensions through generic_xlog.c.

logicalmsg_redo.overview: RM_LOGICALMSG_ID redo. Records logical decoding messages; redo path itself is mostly a no-op (decoding does the real work).

RmgrData.overview: Method-table struct: rm_name, rm_redo, rm_desc, rm_identify, rm_startup, rm_cleanup, rm_mask, rm_decode. One instance per resource manager in RmgrTable[].

TimeLineHistoryEntry.overview: tli, begin (inclusive), end (exclusive). A list of these forms the history.

XLogCtl.overview: XLOG-side shared-memory struct (xlog.c). Holds Insert pos, RedoRecPtr, ckptFullXid, SharedRecoveryState, lastFpwDisableRecPtr, lastSegSwitchTime, etc. Distinct from XLogRecoveryCtl.

XLogRecoveryCtl.overview: Recovery-only shared-memory struct (xlogrecovery.c). Fields: lastReplayedReadRecPtr, lastReplayedEndRecPtr, lastReplayedTLI, replayEndRecPtr, replayEndTLI, recoveryLastXTime, currentChunkStartTime, abortedRecPtr, missingContrecPtr, recoveryWakeupLatch, SharedHotStandbyActive, SharedPromoteIsTriggered, recoveryPause.

StandbyMode.overview: Global bool. True iff standby.signal was found at startup. Drives whether the source-selection state machine ever consults the streaming source and whether replay loops indefinitely vs ends at recovery_target.

ArchiveRecoveryRequested.overview: Global bool. True iff recovery.signal or standby.signal was found. Toggles InitWalRecovery into archive-recovery mode (validateRecoveryParameters, restore_command).

reachedConsistency.overview: Global bool. Set by CheckRecoveryConsistency once we replay past minRecoveryPoint and backupEndPoint. Required before HotStandbyActive can return true.

InRecovery.overview: Global bool exported via xlogutils.h. Distinct from RecoveryInProgress(): InRecovery is true only while the startup process is actively replaying; cleared once StartupXLOG enters production.

standbyState.overview: Enum {STANDBY_DISABLED, STANDBY_INITIALIZED, STANDBY_SNAPSHOT_PENDING, STANDBY_SNAPSHOT_READY}. Tracks how far standby setup has progressed; gates KnownAssignedXids tracking and conflict resolution.

GetXLogReplayRecPtr.overview: Public accessor returning XLogRecoveryCtl->lastReplayedEndRecPtr (and replayTLI). Used by walsender, monitoring views, and CreateRestartPoint.

GetCurrentReplayRecPtr.overview: Returns replayEndRecPtr/replayEndTLI, the START of the currently-being-applied record. Used by xlog_redo's TLI cross-check.

SetRecoveryPause.overview: Sets XLogRecoveryCtl->recoveryPauseState. Wakes the redo loop via WakeupRecovery so it sees the new value at the next pause-point.

GetRecoveryPauseState.overview: Returns the recovery pause state for pg_get_wal_replay_pause_state().

pg_wal_replay_pause.overview: SQL function. Sets recoveryPauseState=PAUSE_REQUESTED via SetRecoveryPause.

pg_wal_replay_resume.overview: SQL function. Clears recoveryPauseState via SetRecoveryPause(false). Wakes the redo loop.

ProcessCommittedInvalidationMessages.overview: Replays sinval messages embedded in commit records on the standby. Drives standby's catalog cache invalidation.

ReadCheckpointRecord.overview: Reads the checkpoint pointed to by pg_control->checkPoint (or the backup_label's checkpoint). Validates the record looks like a checkpoint.

verifyBackupPageConsistency.overview: When wal_consistency_checking is enabled, replays the FPI shadow buffer through rm_mask and compares against the post-redo buffer. Diagnostic only, runs after rm_redo.

AdvanceNextFullTransactionIdPastXid.overview: Ensures TransamVariables->nextXid is greater than every XID seen during replay so that, post-recovery, no production transaction reuses a recovered XID.

WalSndWakeupProcessRequests.overview: Wakes physical and/or logical walsenders after the redo loop applies a record. Enables cascading replication: the standby acts as a feed for downstream standbys.

max_standby_archive_delay.overview: GUC. Maximum time the redo loop will wait before canceling conflicting backends when WAL came from the archive (or pg_wal). Default 30s. -1 = wait forever.

max_standby_streaming_delay.overview: GUC. Maximum time the redo loop will wait before canceling conflicting backends when WAL came from streaming. Default 30s.

hot_standby_feedback.overview: GUC. When true, walreceiver periodically sends GetOldestActiveTransactionId() to the primary so vacuum on the primary respects the standby's xmin.

EnableHotStandby.overview: GUC: 'hot_standby'. Boolean. When true (and wal_level>=replica), the standby allows backends to connect and run read-only queries after consistent recovery.

log_recovery_conflict_waits.overview: GUC. When true, conflict-resolution waits longer than deadlock_timeout get logged with the resolver name and the affected backends.

recovery_prefetch.overview: GUC enum {off, on, try}. Controls whether XLogPrefetcher actively prefetches blocks during recovery; 'try' enables only when AIO is supported.

maintenance_io_concurrency.overview: GUC. Sets the prefetch lookahead distance for the recovery prefetcher (and other maintenance paths).
